name: Sumsub
tagline: Global KYC/AML identity verification and compliance API
description: Sumsub provides KYC/AML identity verification, applicant and document workflows, transaction monitoring, and Travel Rule capabilities. Its signed REST API manages applicants, verification actions, documents, transactions, and results. End-user liveness and face-authentication capture runs through WebSDK or MobileSDK; REST endpoints can create relevant actions and retrieve results.

auth.details: App token + HMAC-SHA256 request signature: X-App-Token header and X-App-Access-Ts / X-App-Access-Sig headers; tokens from dashboard

pricing.free_tier_limits: 14-day free trial with 50 free completed checks; extra services may still be charged. No ongoing free plan.

rate_limits: Default: 300 GET requests per 5 seconds and 50 POST requests per 5 seconds. Sumsub may increase these limits upon request.

example.request: curl -X GET 'https://api.sumsub.com/resources/applicants/-;externalUserId=USER_ID/one' -H 'X-App-Token: YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'X-App-Access-Ts: TIMESTAMP' -H 'X-App-Access-Sig: SIGNATURE' -H 'Accept: application/json'

use_cases: create a KYC applicant and start identity verification
check applicant verification status by external user id
submit ID document images for verification
run liveness/face match checks for onboarding
monitor transactions for AML and Travel Rule compliance
